if not EXISTS (SELECT * from sys.tables t JOIN sys.schemas s on t.schema_id=s.schema_id WHERE t.name ='DimCustomer' and s.name='gold')
    CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE gold.Dimcustomer
     WITH 
     (
         location ='DimCustomer',
         data_source =gold_source,
         file_format=parquet_format
     )
    as
        SELECT
            DISTINCT
            customerID,
            CustomerName,
            CustomerEmail,
            Domain ,
            ROW_NUMBER()OVER (ORDER BY customerID) as DimCustomerKey
        FROM silver.Silvertable


select * from gold.Dimcustomer
